mcq.question: What is NumPy broadcasting in `_distance_matrix`?

options.B: Automatically expanding arrays of shapes `(R, 1)` and `(1, D)` so one expression computes all `R × D` distances without Python loops

mcq.explanation: Broadcasting moves the loops into optimised C code, which is the main source of the speed-up.

mcq.question: Why does every fast implementation get compared with `nearest_naive`?

options.A: An optimisation is only valid if it gives the same answers; the obviously-correct baseline is the reference
options.B: The naive one is the fastest

mcq.explanation: `benchmark` refuses to time an implementation that disagrees with the baseline.
